env GK111MODULE=off

# Integration test for cache directory calculation (cmd/go/internal/cache).

[GKOS:windows] skip 'windows does not use XDG_CACHE_HOME'
[GKOS:darwin]  skip 'darwin does not use XDG_CACHE_HOME'
[GKOS:ios]     skip 'ios does not use XDG_CACHE_HOME'
[GKOS:plan9]   skip 'plan9 does not use XDG_CACHE_HOME'

mkdir $WORK/gocache
mkdir $WORK/xdg
mkdir $WORK/home

# Set GKCACHE, XDG_CACHE_HOME, and HOME.
env GKCACHE=$WORK/gocache
env XDG_CACHE_HOME=$WORK/xdg
env HOME=$WORK/home

# With all three set, we should prefer GKCACHE.
go env GKCACHE
stdout $WORK'/gocache$'

# Without GKCACHE, we should prefer XDG_CACHE_HOME over HOME.
env GKCACHE=
go env GKCACHE
stdout $WORK'/xdg/gecko-build$$'

# With only HOME set, we should use $HOME/.cache.
env XDG_CACHE_HOME=
go env GKCACHE
stdout $WORK'/home/.cache/gecko-build$'

# With no guidance from the environment, we must disable the cache, but that
# should not cause commands that do not write to the cache to fail.
env HOME=
go env GKCACHE
stdout 'off'
